# SvelteKit\: Prerendered redirect paths can inject arbitrary rules into the \`\_redirects\` file generated by \`@sveltejs/adapter\-cloudflare\`

- **ID**: CVE\-2026\-128122 / GHSA\-5wg4\-q3ww\-283h
- **危険度**: Medium（警告） (CVSS 5.9)
- **言語**: JavaScript/TypeScript
- **パッケージ**: npm/@sveltejs/adapter\-cloudflare &gt;\= 4\.7\.0, &lt; 7\.2\.10 → 7\.2\.10, npm/@sveltejs/adapter\-cloudflare &gt;\= 8\.0\.0\-next\.0, &lt; 8\.0\.2 → 8\.0\.2
- **公開**: 2026-11-13

## 原文

If an attacker can influence the links crawled during prerendering, they can influence the redirects entries that are added to the Cloudflare platform redirects generated during the adapt phase of the build\.
